title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions & deps
author: Maya Chen
description: Consolidate our repository-wide GitHub Actions into a smaller set of reusable workflows and upgrade pinned action versions and node toolchains. Motivation: reduce CI maintenance overhead, speed up matrix runs by centralizing common steps, and resolve flaky lint/test failures caused by mixing Node 16/18 runners. This PR: 1) Splits lint/test/release into focused workflows but consolidates shared logic into .github/workflows/workflow-templates/*.yml; 2) Upgrades official actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) and standardizes Node to 20 in build/test steps; 3) Adds caching hygiene for NPM/Yarn and action cache; 4) Removes duplicated job definitions across many repo-level workflows; 5) Updates automation for release notes to use new release-bot config and fixes tagging race conditions; 6) Small package.json devDependency bumps (eslint, typescript, mocha) to resolve security alerts. See commits list for detailed deltas. This is a repo-hygiene change with no runtime changes to production services (CI-only).
commits: chore(ci): extract common job template to .github/workflows/templates/common-jobs.yml

code_snippets: # new shared job template snippet: uses: actions/checkout@v4
setup-node: uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' cache: 'npm'
cache-restore: uses: actions/cache@v4 with: path: ~/.npm, key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
conversation: Arjun Patel (reviewer): Can we keep a short-lived compatibility matrix for Node 18 on release jobs until infra is fully migrated? Some enterprise customers still use Node 18 in on-prem installers.
Maya Chen (author): Good point; adjusted release.yml to run a Node 18 job for the release workflow only (kept to 1 parallel job). Added a note in docs/ci.md about migration timeline.
Samir Gupta (reviewer): Why bump eslint here? I worry about unexpected lint rulings on legacy packages. Please run eslint --fix across affected packages or opt-in per repo.
Maya Chen (author): Ran eslint --fix for redwood and sdk packages. Left a changelog entry for manual fixes that were intentionally not autofixed. See package.json devDep changes.
Elena Morris (approver): CI runs look stable after the cache fix. Approving pending a green CI run and a short smoke test in staging for release flow.

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows and upgraded GitHub Actions and Node toolchain to v20. Dev dependencies updated for lint/test stability. No production code changes.
notes_for_operators: After merge, monitor the release workflow for one release cycle to confirm Node 18 compatibility job is sufficient for on-prem installers. Inform platform teams about standardized Node 20 images.
additional_context: This change reduces duplication across repositories and should shorten average CI runtime by ~12% on shared runners (estimated from sampling). The shared templates make future action upgrades easier follow-up PRs will migrate additional repos to the templates.
human_readable_summary: Consolidates multiple repository CI workflows into shared templates, upgrades actions and Node versions, fixes cache behavior, and bumps devDeps for repo hygiene. Merged via squash after green CI.
